### [`copy_source_bitmap_offsets`](../../../../src/tools/copy_368f.asm#L6) `$368F-$3691`

*data*

<a id="copy_source_colour_bases"></a>
### [`copy_source_colour_bases`](../../../../src/tools/copy_368f.asm#L9) `$3692`

*data*

2 bytes for each copy_source (0 and 2): the high byte of the source screen colours ($d0, $d8), then the distance to the source colour RAM ($04).

- **Read by:** [`copy_tool`](copy.md#copy_tool)
